theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_cmc_40fde013_floor_remainder
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (κ α C : ℝ), 0 ≤ α → 0 ≤ C → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → |(∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a k) - κ * (n : ℝ)| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ α) → Measurable (fun t : ℝ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.floor t), a k) - κ * t) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → |(∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.floor t), a k) - κ * t| ≤ (C + |κ|) * t ^ α
